test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Raju lost 13% by selling a radio set for ₹4,524. What percentage of profit would he have earned by selling it for ₹6,400 (rounded off to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

Loss Percentage (L) = 13%

Selling Price (SP) = ₹4,524

New Selling Price (SP') = ₹6,400

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = dfrac{SP times 100}{100 - L}

Profit Percentage (P) = dfrac{SP' - CP}{CP} times 100
